rules.name: Movement Distance Limit
rules.explanation: A unit may move up to its Movement (M) value in inches during the movement phase. This check validates that the distance is at least 1 inch (unit moved at all).
rules.suggestedFix: Ensure the target position is between 0 and M inches away.

rules.name: Cannot Move from Engagement Range
rules.explanation: A unit locked in engagement range cannot make normal moves. Units in engagement must either stay in place or attempt to fall back.
rules.suggestedFix: Choose a different unit to move, or attempt a Fall Back action instead.

rules.name: Maintain Unit Coherency
rules.explanation: After moving, squad members must maintain coherency (be within 2 inches of at least one other squad member). This rule checks that the move maintains coherency.
rules.suggestedFix: Reposition models to ensure all are within 2 inches of the unit.

rules.name: Fall Back Movement Distance
rules.explanation: A unit that falls back moves up to 6 inches away from enemy units.
rules.suggestedFix: Ensure the fall back move is not more than 6 inches.

rules.name: Advance Movement Distance
rules.explanation: A unit that advances moves up to 10 inches but cannot charge this turn.
rules.suggestedFix: Ensure the advance move does not exceed 10 inches.
